full_text:
In a quiet country town in Denmark lived two brothers, Anders and Hans Christian. From childhood, they shared an unquenchable thirst for knowledge, reading ancient classics and studying the laws of nature.

They entered the university in Copenhagen poor in money but rich in genius. One brother became the supreme chancellor of justice, upholding the laws with unblemished righteousness; the other, Hans Christian Oersted, discovered the secret bond between electricity and magnetism, revolutionizing the science of the world!

The brothers remained united in humble love, demonstrating that truth in science and justice in society are twin blossoms springing from the same divine root.
moral: When scientific genius and judicial righteousness walk hand in hand, a nation is illuminated.
